2577-5670-6559.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6559.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2099-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
2099-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
2099-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3220-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3220-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

3375-4399-4770-6719.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4770-6719.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

412-3081-3817-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ancestor's Chosen.
When Ancestor's Chosen dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Ancestor's Chosen from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Ancestor's Chosen enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2103-2974-5131.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
2103-2974-5131.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Repository Skaab either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1268-2097-3809-4917.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
1268-2097-3809-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
1268-2097-3809-4917.notes: Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.

703-3734-7149.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phyrexian Metamorph dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Phyrexian Metamorphs into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Phyrexian Metamorph tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-3734-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

1061-1251-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-1251-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-1251-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

1129-1978-2392.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
1129-1978-2392.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat

997-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2459-5220-5683-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Rograkh from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Rograkh and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

413-618-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Lightning Crafter token's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 9.
Repeat from step 4.

235-731-4150.description:
Cast Shivan Meteor by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 13 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent thirteen poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

859-1818-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Lurking Roper.
859-1818-4702.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Wormfang Drake

372-465-4284.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Clone until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Clone leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Clone from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Clone enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Wormfang Drake.
Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

262-719-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Coercive Recruiter.
Coercive Recruiter does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
262-719-2534.description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield as Pirates due to Xenograft, Coercive Recruiter triggers four times.
Resolve the first three triggers, causing you to gain control of up to three other creatures and untap them.
Resolve the last trigger, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this during each of your turns to gain control of all creatures during your turn.

1810-1872-1953-2011.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Composite Golem.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing each token you control to become a copy of the Composite Golem token.
Activate the Myr by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1409-2602-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Deadeye Navigator paired with Lord of Change.
1409-2602-4067.description:
Activate Lord of Change by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Lord of Change enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Lord of Change ability, causing you to draw three cards.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it with Lord of Change.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping an Island you control.
Active the Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have drawn your library, you may activate Mind Over Matter many times to untap lands, creatures, and artifacts you control.
You may use the mana generated this way to activate Deadeye Navigator and the blinking abilities of creatures paired with Deadeye Navigator many times.

553-807-1403-3212.description:
Move to your draw step, drawing Approach of the Second Sun and revealing it due to God-Eternal Kefnet's ability.
Resolve God-Eternal Kefnet's trigger, copying Approach of the Second Sun and casting the copy from your hand by paying {4}{W}.
Sunbird's Invocation triggers.
In response, activate Brainstone by paying {2}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, drawing three cards and putting Approach of the Second Sun and another card on top of your library.
Resolve the Sunbird's Invocation trigger, revealing the top seven cards of your library, casting Approach of the Second Sun without paying its mana cost, then putting the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Approach of the Second Sun, putting it back into your library seventh from the top and gaining you 7 life.
Resolve the remaining copy of Approach of the Second Sun.
